# FG-REVIEW-0025

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_head_with_no_open_merge_request_is_neutral_and_not_assessed` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この変更の危険を、すべては確かめられていません。チェック forge/risk の理由を確かめてください。
- en: The risk of this change could not be fully assessed. Read the reasons in the forge/risk check.
- id: Risiko perubahan ini belum dapat dinilai sepenuhnya. Baca alasannya pada pemeriksaan forge/risk.

## 原因 (cause)

The check `forge/risk` (M3 X7) could not assess part of the head: no open merge request has this head any more, the target branch is gone, the target shares no history with the head, a changed path is not UTF-8, or more files changed than the content scan reads (the remainder is counted in the summary). It is a `warn`: the run concludes `neutral`, never `success`, so an unassessed head is never reported as safe. (A change of more than 5000 files is `stop`, FG-REVIEW-0023.)

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Open the run: gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <head>; the finding's rule names the reason (`no_open_merge_request`, `target_missing`, `no_common_history`, `non_utf8_path`, `content_not_scanned`). The event `forge.risk.recorded` carries the same.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing on the server. For no_open_merge_request / target_missing, open or retarget the merge request: a new head is assessed again. For non_utf8_path rename the path.
